elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data in standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format — 'commonly used' rather than a standard format, and the duty is 'return or make available for export'

elements.element: Return within 30 days of expiry or termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of Customer's request — deadline runs from a later request, not from expiry or termination
thereafter delete Customer Data ... and certify such deletion in writing
for up to six (6) months (exceeds 90 days)
within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data

reasons: The locked target level is preferred, but the 30-day return deadline runs from 'Customer's request' rather than from expiry or termination, so the mandatory post-termination return is swallowed by a request condition.
'commonly used, machine-readable format' does not expressly deliver the preferred 'standard machine-readable format'.
New duties are triggered by termination of 'any Order Form', which extends the trigger beyond the Agreement and could disrupt continuing Services.
Fallback elements (90 days assistance; export within 30 days) are satisfied, so the inserted clause sits at the fallback rather than the preferred position.
Insertion is concise and fills a genuine gap (no existing return/transition duty); untouched sentences remain effective and no undefined term is introduced.
